spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin on a new 20-day high after at least 3 sessions since the prior marker, with exit within 2-6 bars.
assumptions: Timeframe chosen as 1d as most natural reading for 'trading sessions', 'next day' and 'candlestick intervals' on BTC daily data.

Direction chosen as long ('Buy entry'); breakout compiled as close gt highest_high(20) with offset 0 which per schema compares the signal-bar close to the PREVIOUS 20 bars (current bar excluded), i.e. close beyond the prior 20-day watermark, filled next bar open as proxy for next-day watermark entry.
Gap rule compiled as no breakout on the prior 2 bars so the previous marker is at least 3 sessions prior.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact limit entry at the prior watermark price and exact structural stop 'below the latest high/low that triggered the signal' use fixed prices the schema cannot anchor; no percent stop is used and the time exit provides the required exit.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: the claim also triggers buys on a new 20-day low; entry arrays are AND-only so high-breakout and low-breakdown triggers cannot be combined as an OR in one testable rule - the high-breakout buy is compiled as the testable core.

evidence.quote: OHLCV historical data for Bitcoin (BTC) from Binance exchange.
The market makes a new 20day high or low
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
The close of the new high/low must be greater than (beyond) the previous high/low price marker.
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals

audit_majors: entry: Claim requires Buy on new 20-day high OR new 20-day low; spec only encodes high-breakout buys and omits low-breakdown buys. Omitting half the entry signals changes what is tested.
stop_loss_pct: Claim requires stop 'below the latest high/low that triggered the signal' for failed trades; spec sets no stop. Leaving out the stop changes risk/exit and verdict.
